notes.title: Kotel Ne Gori 1.2
notes.content:
Patchnote:

 Fix for Vladik missing at begining of stage
 Dimasik now have more face animations and effects
 Checkpoint notification improved
 Better transitions and smoother camera in cutscenes
 New text effect

notes.title: Kotel just got better
notes.content:
Patch notes:

 fixed glitch that propelled you at start of map
 fixed sudden despawning of Vladik
 new shader
 checkpoint effect got better visuals

notes.title: Vladik to the rescue
notes.content:
Patch notes:

 Boss wing effect fixed
 More bricks
 Dancing shark added to final map
 Vladik NPC
 Characters now wear sunglasses!

notes.title: Even more Kotel
notes.content:
Even more fidelity update:

 Double Jump introduced
 Back vocals on last stages were improved
 Rakes now burn away
 Improved visual effects
 Vladik is now much more family-friendly

notes.title: Kotel Fidelity Update
notes.content:
Kotel Fidelity Update:

 Ambient sound introduced
 Crosshair
 Increased hitbox for boss
 Improved visual effects
